name: Zara Kim
role: Small-time data broker and bootleg media seller
location: The Shelf, Deepwell Station, near sub-level access near State and Van Buren
description:
Zara Kim is a heavyset man with pale Polish-Armenian complexion gone ruddy at the cheeks from years of Deepwell Station's recycled air, a close-cropped head of dark hair shot through with early gray, and a mustache he maintains with a precision that is otherwise entirely absent from his personal presentation. He wears the same rotation of three utilitarian jackets and always has a data-chip case on his belt that holds sixty to eighty chips in organized categories only he understands. His stall at The Shelf is a folding table with a locked case on top and a handwritten placard reading 'MEDIA / INFORMATION / REASONABLE RATES.' Behind it he keeps a battered terminal and a cup of something hot that he refills compulsively from a thermos.

Zara Kim has the careful, watchful energy of a man who has heard a lot of things he wasn't meant to and survived by being boring about it. He is dry-humored and unhurried, speaks with precise economy, and will sell you bootleg Axiom entertainment packages and Tessera corporate gossip compilations with the same mild demeanor. He does not volunteer what he knows, but ask him the right question and pay the right amount and the depth of his archive is quietly staggering. His specialty is organizational intelligence — who works for whom, who owes what, which corponation is about to restructure which subsidiary — sourced from document leaks, intercepted internal newsletters, and a network of low-level administrative workers who trade gossip for data access.

core_fears: The wrong person finding out exactly how much he knows
That his archive is the only thing of value he has left
core_desires: Financial stability solid enough that he stops calculating risk every morning
To be genuinely respected for his expertise, not just tolerated as useful
coping_mechanisms: Obsessive organization — the chip case, the files, the archive categories
blind_spots: He's been boring for so long as a survival strategy that he's lost the ability to assess when being boring stops protecting him
He underestimates how much people like him
psychology.secret: He has a complete dossier on the Sump Principals gang leadership — finances, membership, operations — compiled over six years out of habit and paranoia. He has never sold it and isn't sure why. He tells himself it's insurance. It might be the closest thing he has to friends.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Compressed, precise, technical when discussing data, unexpectedly dry wit deployed without tonal change so it takes a second to land
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow, even, never hurried. Comfortable with silence in a way that makes others uncomfortable.
verbal_tics: 'That'll run you—' followed by a number with no preamble
example_lines: 'Tessera internal newsletter, Q3 restructuring, full text, annotated. Φ18. You want the annotation or not.'
'I've heard that name. Whether I've heard it in a context relevant to you is a different question with a different price.'

story_hooks: The Zheng-Dao auditor who feeds him documents has gone silent for three weeks, and the last thing they sent him was a file he cannot open — it requires a decryption key that corresponds to a physical object somewhere in Deepwell Station
Someone has started selling information clearly sourced from his archive, undercutting his prices — either he has a leak in his network or someone has physically accessed his chips
narrative_function: Information broker, quest giver, knowledge resource about corponation internal politics, can provide documents and data at a price, knows who's moving and why
augmentations: Subdermal data port (left wrist, for fast chip reading); basic neural cache — 12TB passive memory storage implant; no cosmetic mods whatsoever
daily_life: He is at the table by 8am with his thermos. He sits. He waits. He reads from a personal chip archive when slow. He goes home at 9pm to an apartment two floors up in the Deepwell residential block and does this again the next day.
affiliation: Independent; pays protection to a Deepwell Station local gang called the Sump Principals; occasional arms-length relationship with a Zheng-Dao internal auditor who feeds him documents

decision_rules: Never sell information about someone to someone who is clearly going to use it to hurt them physically — he's a data broker, not a targeting system
Always know two exit routes from any location
escalation_ladder: Claims he doesn't have what they're asking for
Quotes an impossibly high price as a discouragement
Closes the case, packs the terminal, and leaves the table in silence

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Neutral, transactional, gives nothing free including warmth
interpersonal_modes.friends: Marginally less neutral — will occasionally offer tea from the thermos unprompted, which is significant

stress_responses.medium: Goes completely transactional — every sentence is about numbers and terms
stress_responses.high: Disappears for 48-72 hours into his apartment; known to emerge with a new archive category as a result

contradictions: Claims information is purely transactional but has never sold the Sump Principals file despite multiple offers
habits: Refills the thermos every ninety minutes regardless of how much is left
Reads every chip he sells before selling it
Mentally catalogs the footwear of everyone who stops at the table — he can tell a lot from footwear
breaking_points: Physical threat to the archive itself
Discovering he's been used as a weapon against someone who trusted him

timeline.event: Born in Deepwell Station to Polish-Armenian descent family; parents both Ferrogate Transit administrative workers
Lost a data entry job at a Zheng-Dao subsidiary in a restructuring; began selling bootleg media to survive
Made first contact with the Zheng-Dao auditor; began trading organizational intelligence
Completed the first full Sump Principals dossier; elected not to sell it
Current: established Shelf presence, archive approaching 40,000 indexed files, auditor contact now silent

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Spiderbite' Electrified Barbed Wire Launcher

physical_description.heritage: Complex Pan-Asian, South Asian, and Middle Eastern blend with Sub-Saharan African admixture. East Asian ancestry (42.3%) defines facial structure and eye shape, substantially enriched by South Asian (23%), Southeast Asian (13.7%), and Middle Eastern (12.5%) heritage, with Sub-Saharan African (8.5%) contributing warmth and depth. A striking synthesis of multiple continental features: warm deep brown skin with golden and olive undertones, angular cheekbones with subtle fullness, monolid and hooded eye shapes, fuller lips from South Asian influence, and facial proportions reflecting the intersection of East, South, and Southeast Asian genetics tempered by Middle Eastern width.
physical_description.build: Heavyset, solid through the shoulders and chest, soft around the midsection from years of sedentary work and institutional food. Thick-limbed but not athletic.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature gray threading through, particularly at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, military-precision cut, maintained weekly at a sub-level barber
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep brown with golden and olive undertones, reflecting the dominant East Asian (42.3%) and South Asian (23%) ancestry blended with Southeast Asian and Middle Eastern warmth; the Sub-Saharan African heritage (8.5%) adds depth and richness. Chronic reddening across cheeks and nose from Deepwell Station's recycled air and irregular ventilation systems overlays the base tone.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered by decades of sub-level lighting; fine lines around the eyes from constant squinting at data terminals; deep vertical crease between the brows from concentration. Cheeks permanently flushed. Facial structure distinctly pan-Asian with South Asian and Middle Eastern influence—prominent but not broad nose with slight bulbousness reflecting South Asian genetics, fuller lips from South Asian admixture, defined angular cheekbones characteristic of East Asian ancestry, with subtle width through the face reflecting Middle Eastern proportion. Monolid eye shape with slight hooding. Meticulously groomed dark, full mustache in stark contrast to the weathered neglect elsewhere. Complexion carries the depth and richness of blended continental ancestry.
distinguishing_marks: Faint surgical scar on the left wrist where subdermal data port was installed, approximately 3cm long, now nearly invisible
Nicotine stains on the index and middle fingers of his right hand from years of handling cheap synthetic cigarettes
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. Subdermal data port at left wrist is healed over and unmarked; neural cache implant is completely internal and undetectable without scanning equipment.
physical_description.posture_movement: Hunched shoulders from hours seated at a folding table; moves with deliberate, economical motions—no wasted energy. Sits with his spine against the chair back, feet flat on the floor, always positioned to see approaches from multiple angles. Stillness is his default state; when he moves, it is purposeful and measured.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian. Three interchangeable synthetic-blend jackets in muted colors (charcoal, dark green, navy) worn in rotation, all showing seams at the elbows and collar stains from years of Deepwell grime. Underneath: plain long-sleeved thermal shirts, worn but clean. Practical cargo pants with multiple pockets. Heavy boots resoled twice. A worn canvas belt with a reinforced data-chip case containing 60-80 organized chips. No jewelry except a functional analog wristwatch. Everything smells faintly of recycled air, old coffee, and industrial cleaner.
